tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij zdania (1.1.-1.6.), wykorzystujac podane w nawiasach wyrazy w odpowiedniej formie. Nie zmieniaj kolejnosci podanych wyrazow, ale w razie potrzeby dodaj inne wyrazy, tak aby otrzymac logiczne i gramatycznie poprawne zdania. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna.

items.context: By the time we got to the hall, the concert _________ (already / begin), so we _________ (miss) the opening song.
Next month I _________ (work) here for six years. I _________ (never / regret) taking the job.
answer: will ('ll) have been working / will ('ll) have worked

items.context: Look at those clouds - it _________ (rain). We _________ (better / take) an umbrella.
She _________ (not / speak) to me since the argument, and I _________ (not / know) why.
While I _________ (wait) for the bus, I _________ (realise) that I had left my keys at home.
This time next week we _________ (lie) on a beach. I _________ (look) forward to it for months.
